sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present transfer application has been filed on the ground that case has been heard by the different Presiding Officers at the relevant point of time and got transferred from one Court to another Court.
However, certain allegations were made against the then Sessions Judge for getting the case decided in favour of the accused persons.
The informant also made similar allegations against the Presiding Officer.
The present transfer application is pending since December, 2024.

3. The learned counsel for the applicant states that whomsoever may be, the Presiding Officer, he does not expect complete justice in deciding the Sessions Trial No. 71 of 2019 (State vs. Jitendra Kumar and 2 others) arising out of Case Crime No.430 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Acchalda, District Auraiya.

entities.text: Sessions Trial No. 71 of 2019 (State vs. Jitendra Kumar and 2 others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the allegations were made in respect of the entire District Judiciary or all Officers, who are competent to decide the session trial, is not likely to get justice at the hands of competent Court of Presiding Officer and further states that adjournments are being given by the concerned Presiding Officer continuously and session trial is still pending final judgment.

5. Having considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the applicant and from the perusal of the record, it appears that one or other allegations have been made against the then Presiding Officer/Sessions Judge in deciding the said sessions trial on one pretext or other.

It is also a matter of record that the officers are being transferred from one district to another district on annual basis and in midterm and least to say that the District Judges are transferred from time to time depending upon the vacancies available at the different districts, on administrative grounds and transfer is a routine exercise to be conducted and regulated by this Court on administrative side.
Amit Kumar Yadav Alias Meeku vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155505751/
1 6.

entities.text: Amit Kumar Yadav Alias Meeku vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under such circumstances, the present transfer application has lost its relevance, since the then District Judge/Presiding Officer has already been transferred to another place, hence it is expected that the Sessions Judge, Auraiya himself or through some nominated officer/Additional Sessions Judge shall take all possible efforts after hearing both the parties, i.e., the prosecution and the defence and then shall proceed in passing final judgment, being away from the allegations levelled and without favour and fear, being impartial, unbiased, neutral and in an independent manner and shall not be swayed by any pressure or threat being extended by either side.

7. It is needless to say that if the allegations and counter allegations are levelled, in such manner then no officer would like to pass any order and the litigants shall be deprived of justice in the process.
Even if any complaint is made, there is a well defined procedure and system to take the matter on administrative side against the said officer.

8. In view of the above, it is directed that the Session Judge either himself or by any other Court of Additional Sessions Judge, competent to decide the said case, and may proceed in accordance with law.
9. In view of the above directions/observations, the present transfer application stands disposed of.
